title: Apple warns of limited iPhone Duo stock for walk-in buyers on launch day
description: The iPhone Duo goes on sale this Friday, October 23, but if you were hoping to just walk into an Apple Store and pick one up, you may want to rethink that plan. In a statement, Apple says there will be "limited" availability for walk-in customers, and given the "extraordinary" demand since pre-orders began last week, it expects that supply to sell out quickly. title: Spotify launches podcast Memberships, creators keep 90% of the revenue
description: Spotify first previewed Memberships at its Investor Day back in May, and today the feature is rolling out in 34 markets. It lets eligible podcast creators charge their biggest fans a monthly fee for exclusive content and perks, and it replaces the podcast subscriptions Spotify introduced in 2021. Creators get to decide what their Membership includes: exclusive audio or video, bonus episodes, fewer ads, early access, access to a show's archive, or all of the above. They can also split their benefits into up to three tiers, each with its own price. Spotify isn't setting prices itself, though...

title: Oppo sets its sights on Europe with faster launches and carrier partnerships
description: Until recently, smartphone makers focused on developing markets to grow their market share as the markets for premium phones were close to saturated. However, the massive increases in memory prices have caused makers to do a 180° turn and focus their attention on the premium market. Memory prices are so high that RAM and storage dominate the bill of materials on entry-level phones, making them unsustainable at their old prices. Meanwhile, premium devices have the margins to better absorb the price increases and they are aimed at a less price-sensitive audience. Oppo has set its...

title: Samsung and SK Hynix are upgrading their NAND factories in China
description: Chinese memory maker YMTC became China’s biggest producer of NAND flash chips this year with a market share of 38.5%, up from 28% last year. This allowed it to overtake Samsung, which is #2 with 33.5% share (down from 36%) and SK Hynix, which is #3 with 17% (down from 20%). So, now the two Korean companies are working on upgrading their production capacity in China. Samsung’s facility in Xian, China, accounts for around 40% of its global NAND production capacity. However, it only makes relatively old chips with around 200 layers (more layers = more storage per chip). There is an ongoing...

description: Hasselblad Teleconverter Kit overview It has become the norm for high-end cameraphones to offer support for a telephoto accessory lens and the Find X10 Pro Max can be outfitted with the Hasselblad Teleconverter Kit. The concept and most of the practical implementation of the teleconverter is the same as on the Find X9 Pro. title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max review
Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max go global
description: Oppo is launching its Find X10 series internationally today. The exact timing will vary from country to country, but Oppo.com has kicked off sales in several regions already. First, we should note that there is a regional difference in the battery capacity. The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max launched with an 8,000mAh battery in China, but European models will ship with 7,150mAh batteries. The same goes for the vanilla X10 – 7,150mAh battery in Europe, down from 8,000mAh in China. title: Honor Win RT2 and Win Turbo2 go official with 12,070mAh batteries
description: Honor has unveiled its Win2 series in China, consisting of the Win2, Win RT2, and Win Turbo2. In this post, we’ll focus on the Win RT2 and Win Turbo2, both of which pack massive 12,070mAh batteries. The Honor Win RT2 is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, paired with LPDDR5X Ultra RAM and UFS 4.1 storage. It also gets in-house display and communication chipsets. The Win RT2 also comes with an in-built active cooling fan that sits within the rear camera island. According to Honor, the fan can reduce temperatures by up to 6 degrees Celsius under load. title: Honor Win2 and Win Tablet launch with built-in fans and big batteries
description: Honor launched the Win in China back in December, and today its successor is official after weeks of teasers and leaks. The Honor Win2 arrives alongside the Win RT2 and Win Turbo2, as well as the company's first Win-branded tablet. The Win2 comes with a 6.89-inch 1440x3104 OLED screen with a 185Hz refresh rate and 10,000-nit peak brightness, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, up to 16GB of RAM and 1TB of storage, a 200MP 1/1.4-inch main camera with OIS, a 12MP ultrawide, a 50MP selfie camera, a 10,100 mAh battery with 100W wired and 80W wireless charging, IP68/IP69/IP69K ratings...

title: vivo Buds Ultra launch in Europe with 60dB ANC and dual drivers
description: Back in June, vivo unveiled the TWS 5 Pro buds in China alongside the X Fold6. Now, what looks like the very same pair of earbuds is making its way to Europe under a new name - vivo Buds Ultra. They use a hybrid driver setup, with an ultra-compact balanced armature co-developed with Knowles sitting in the center of the diaphragm of a dual-fold dynamic driver developed by vivo. The company says this coaxial design aligns the acoustic centers of the bass and treble for a balanced sound, while a dedicated acoustic tube physically isolates high and low frequencies. title: vivo X500 Ultra said to use a larger telephoto sensor over its predecessor
description: Back in July, well-known tipster Digital Chat Station claimed that vivo was deciding between three 200MP sensors for the telephoto camera on its upcoming camera flagship, the X500 Ultra. Now, the tipster suggests that the company may have made its choice. According to a recent post by the tipster, the latest engineering sample of the vivo X500 Ultra is testing a 200MP 1/1.2-inch sensor for the telephoto camera. vivo appears to have found a way to accommodate the larger sensor without taking up too much internal space. title: Omdia: foldable displays shipments will increase 44% this year with a focus on wide foldables
description: Foldables are growing in popularity – market research firm Omdia forecasts that foldable display shipments will rise by an impressive 44% this year, after a 12% decline last year. Note that the forecast is specifically for the inner displays of foldables and not the foldables themselves – there may be some delay between the time the display component is shipped and when the final product is shipped. According to the forecast, 29 million foldable displays will be shipped this year. As noted above, this might not translate 1:1 into the number of foldable phones shipped, but it’s clear...

title: Lava Aura Curve unveiled with curved display, rear screen, and 6,000mAh battery
description: Lava recently unveiled the Virat Curve in India, featuring a curved display and a secondary screen on the back. The company has now introduced the Aura Curve, which offers the same design and specifications but is aimed at the offline market. The Lava Aura Curve will be available through offline retailers across India, priced at INR 23,999 for the 6GB/128GB variant. The Aura Curve comes with the MediaTek Dimensity 7100 SoC, a 6.67-inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate, a secondary rear AMOLED display, and a 6,000mAh battery with 45W fast charging support. title: Redmi K100 to get a 50MP rear camera, ultrasonic fingerprint scanner
description: Redmi has revealed more details about the K100 ahead of its launch in China on October 26. The phone will join the Redmi K100 Pro and K100 Pro Max, which were unveiled in August. The Redmi K100 will feature a dual-rear camera setup, headlined by a 50MP Light and Shadow Hunter 800 main sensor with a 1/1.55-inch sensor size and an f/1.68 aperture. The phone is also confirmed to offer an IP68 rating for dust and water resistance, along with an ultrasonic in-display fingerprint scanner. title: Coolpad unveils the Cool X Wide with a 16:10 display and 50MP camera
description: Chinese smartphone maker Coolpad isn’t a brand we cover often, but the company has just launched the Cool X Wide, a widescreen smartphone similar to the Huawei Pura X View. Naturally, we had to take a closer look. The Coolpad Cool X Wide features a 6.38-inch LCD display with an HD resolution, a 90Hz refresh rate, and a wide 16:10 aspect ratio. It is powered by the MediaTek Helio G99 chipset, which is paired with up to 12GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 256GB of UFS 2.2 storage. description: Oppo's Reno17 series is rumored to launch in China next month, and today prolific tipster Digital Chat Station has revealed the key specs of the Reno17 Pro. title: Apple caps iPhone Duo purchases at two per person in an attempt to tackle scalpers
description: Apple opened the iPhone Duo pre-orders about four days ago and seconds after the shipping dates slipped into January next year. With every product in extremely high demand and low on stock, scalpers gather and try to buy the item in large quantities and then sell it at an inflated price. That's why Apple now imposes a limit of two iPhone Duos per customer. The limit has so far been confirmed in the US, UK, Japan and Spain, but it's likely worldwide.
